name: Borosil Scientific Ltd
about: Since 1962, Borosil is into finest quality scientific and laboratory glassware, which is used in Quality Control in pharmaceutical industries, Food and Soil testing, Microbiology, and Biotechnology.[1]
keyPoints:
Borosil Group[1]
The company is a part of Borosil group which is into glassware and laboratory products,
scientific & industrial glassware, consumer & kitchenware products, and solar glass products. Group comprises of:
1. Borosil Renewables Ltd
2. Borosil Ltd
3. Borosil Scientific Ltd

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 125 days to 86.0 days
cons: Stock is trading at 2.76 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
